newsitem.title: USA: Twin Disc Q3 net rises on productivity.
newsitem.headline: Twin Disc Q3 net rises on productivity.

text.p: Twin Disc Inc said Friday it posted higher earnings in the third quarter ended March 31 primarily because of improved productivity at its domestic manufacturing operation.

The company, which makes heavy-duty power transmission equipment and related products, said net income reached $1.9 million, or $0.69 a share, compared to $1.8 million, or $0.65, last year. Sales rose to $49.2 million from $47.2 million, Twin Disc said.
The backlog of new orders to be shipped in the next six months stands at $77 million, five percent higher than the backlog reported a year ago, Twin Disc said.
The company's shares were off 1/4 Friday at 24-7/8.
